name: Click Frames GD
description: Record a run, replay it and see/hear the frames between your clicks.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: record: play the level normally and finish it to save the recording. replay: replays the saved recording (your own clicks are ignored) and shows/plays the frames between clicks.

replay-offset.name: Replay offset (frames)
replay-offset.description: If the replay dies or clicks a frame late/early, change this by 1 or -1.
